iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 74. CRITICAL: Islamabad talks COLLAPSED - US demands 20-yr enrichment freeze, Iran offers 5 yrs. BREAKING: Pakistan officials confirm Iran WILLING for 2nd round in Islamabad this week. IAEA locked out 8+ months - cannot verify enrichment status. IAEA DG Grossi urges 'very detailed' verification in any deal. NPT Review Conference Apr 27. AP: half of Iran's enriched uranium likely at Isfahan, rest dispersed at Natanz/Fordow or hidden. CNN: US/Israel targeting nuclear scientists. Iran rejects Trump claim on surrendering nuclear material. Experts: stockpile could yield up to 10 bombs. Probability 40%. Rising.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 74. CRITICAL: Hormuz RE-CLOSED Apr 18 - IRGC fired on 3+ commercial vessels including Indian-flagged ships. 8 India-bound ships turned back. Politco: Iran doubles down on closing Hormuz as ceasefire nears expiration. Trump: 'won't extend ceasefire' - ceasefire expires TOMORROW Apr 22. Trump says US military 'LOCKED AND LOADED.' US pushing for long-term deal requiring Iran to abandon enrichment. Pakistan says Iran WILLING for 2nd round talks this week in Islamabad. Xi calls for Hormuz to stay open. Iran seized US-linked ship Apr 19. Oil prices extremely volatile - spiked then dropped 10% on brief reopening, now spiking again. UK 'to flirt with recession' from oil shock. Death toll 3,375+. Probability 55%. Rising.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 74. STABLE: 10-day ceasefire Day 5, mostly holding, expires Apr 26. Hezbollah not formal signatory - approaching with 'caution and vigilance.' Hezbollah claims attack destroyed Israeli tanks - NOT part of deal, remains armed. Israel holding 10km buffer zone inside Lebanon. Reuters: deal does not require Lebanon to disarm Hezbollah. In-principle extension agreement reported. NYT: ceasefire removes major obstacle in US-Iran talks. Probability 17%. Stable.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: NATO now has 3 Patriot batteries in Turkey. Third ballistic missile from Iran intercepted in Turkish airspace by NATO forces. Roketsan opened Europe's largest warhead plant. TAYFUN Block-4 missiles delivered. Probability 5%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: ELEVATED: 8 India-bound ships returned after attempting Hormuz crossing Apr 18. IRGC fired on Indian-flagged vessels including tanker Sanmar Herald. Pakistan oil tanker made rare entry/exit. CFR warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely in 2026. Hormuz closure threatens India energy imports severely. India and Pakistan offering escorts for ships. Probability 8%. Rising.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 76. RISING: Finland parliament vote on nuclear weapons hosting imminent - government proposal would allow transport/possession of nuclear weapons on Finnish soil. First of 64 F-35A nuclear-capable jets arriving 2026. Kremlin: deployment poses threat, will force countermeasures. Finnish professor warns Finland could be first target in NATO-Russia war. Denmark intel: Russia ready for localized war in 6 months. Lavrov warns Russia's patience 'not unlimited.' Last US-Russia nuclear pact expired Feb 2026. Probability 36%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: CRITICAL: US intelligence confirmed by multiple outlets: China preparing MANPADS (shoulder-fired missiles) shipment to Iran - advanced radar, air defense systems. Bloomberg, CNN, Military.com confirm. Taipei Times confirms. Xi calls for Hormuz to stay open. NYT: Iran's resistance offers uncomfortable lessons for China re Taiwan. US redeploying from Pacific to Middle East benefits China strategically. Analysts: China may use Iran arms as bargaining chip re Taiwan in upcoming Trump-Xi summit. ISW: PRC Taiwan infiltration documented. Probability 50%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 72. RISING: Launched 5 tactical ballistic missiles from Sinpo Apr 19 - 7th test of 2026. Kim 'great satisfaction' over new Hwasong-11 variant with high precision at 136km. Japan strongly protested. Bloomberg: Kim ramps up tests as US reportedly curbs intel to Seoul. Anti-ship/cruise missiles tested from Choe Hyon destroyer Apr 13. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Polymarket: missile test by Apr 30 at 100%. Probability 15%. Rising.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1177+. RISING: Russia launched one of LARGEST attacks of 2026 - 659 drones + 44 missiles (24 ballistic from Iskander), 16+ killed, 118+ wounded. ISW assessments continue daily. Ukraine devastating Russian oil infrastructure - 40% export capacity disabled. Germany commits EUR300M + 5,000 drones. Lavrov: Russia's patience 'not unlimited.' IMF revised Russia growth up on oil windfall. Polymarket ceasefire by Apr 30: 0.4%. ISW: Russia centralizing drone units, may degrade operations. Probability 39%. Rising.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: STABLE: 'Open war' continues - Pakistan bombed major cities including Kabul. China-mediated Urumqi 2nd round concluded - agreed not to escalate but fighting continues at lower intensity. Pakistan operations against Taliban to continue despite peace talks. NPR confirms China brokering. Probability 5%. Stable.
